article_manifest.title: African Tirailleur Day: A tribute to their memory and a show of solidarity
article_manifest.original_title: Journée du Tirailleur africain : Un hommage à la mémoire et un élan de solidarité
article_manifest.summary: African Tirailleur Day was commemorated on Thursday, 26 November 2026, at Place de la Révolution in Ouagadougou, under the theme 'Veterans' Commitment: What Lessons Can We Learn?'. The ceremony highlighted the continuity of the patriotic struggle, with tributes to veterans, a call for discipline among the forces involved and the presentation of a financial contribution to the national effort.

article_manifest.original_title: Mali : Assimi Goïta réunit les chefs d'état-major et fixe ses priorités militaires
article_manifest.summary: Au Mali, le général d’armée Assimi Goïta a réuni mardi 24 novembre 2026, au matin, les chefs d’état-major et les responsables de services des Forces de Défense et de Sécurité (FDS). Le chef de l’État, également chef suprême des Armées, voulait faire le point sur la sécurité du territoire et sur la collaboration entre les unités. « La mobilisation et l’efficacité des Forces de Défense et de Sécurité demeurent une priorité absolue », écrit l’état-major dans son communiqué publié le lendemain.

article_manifest.title: San : le commissariat et le CAP ciblés par une attaque
article_manifest.original_title: San : le commissariat et le CAP ciblés par une attaque
article_manifest.summary: Le commissariat de police et le centre d’animation pédagogique de San ont été attaqués mardi 24 novembre 2026, vers 20 heures. Le gardien du CAP a perdu la vie lors de l’attaque selon des sources locales. Elles ajoutent qu’un policier et un militaire ont été blessés.

article_manifest.title: Why are jihadist groups kidnapping civilians in the Sahel?
article_manifest.original_title: Pourquoi les groupes djihadistes enlèvent des civils dans le Sahel ?
article_manifest.summary: A Saudi national was reportedly kidnapped by jihadist groups last weekend. According to sources contacted by the Reuters news agency, the kidnapping reportedly took place in Niger, in the Tillabéry region, in the tri-border area. So far, there has been no comment from either country, but the kidnapping of civilians is an important source of funding for jihadist groups.

article_manifest.title: Insecurity: 11 soldiers killed and 22 attackers neutralised in a Boko Haram attack in Baroua (Diffa)
article_manifest.original_title: Insécurité : 11 soldats tués et 22 assaillants neutralisés lors d'une attaque de Boko Haram à Baroua (Diffa)
article_manifest.summary: In a statement issued on 24 November, the Ministry of Defence announced that eleven (11) Nigerien soldiers had lost their lives and several others had been injured in a terrorist attack attributed to Boko Haram in Baroua, in the Diffa region, in the far south-east of the country. According to the same source, in their response, the defence and security forces neutralised 22 attackers, and pursuit and sweep operations were immediately launched in this border area of Lake Chad.

"These operations resulted in the neutralisation of at least a dozen terrorists and the disabling of seven (07) motorcycles," the General Staff wrote.

article_manifest.summary: داكار: تنحرف طائرة مسيرة ملغومة رباعية المراوح بشدة وتستهدف مركبة عسكرية روسية ثم تنقض عليها لتدميرها، وتحوم مسيرة أخرى فوق مطار، وتخطئ ضربة بفارق ضئيل نفاثة لكنها تصيب ثلاثة رجال قيل إنهم روس. وصارت مقاطع فيديو تظهر فيها طائرات تنقل إلى مشغليها صورا مباشرة لما تراه كاميراتها أثناء استهداف قوات روسية مشهدا مألوفا مع استمرار الحرب في أوكرانيا. لكن هذه المقاطع ليست من أوكرانيا، بل من مالي التي تبعد عنها خمسة آلاف كيلومتر عند أطراف الصحراء الكبرى.

article_manifest.title: Agadez: The Governor chairs a regular meeting of the Regional Security Council (RSC)
article_manifest.original_title: Agadez : Le Gouverneur préside une réunion ordinaire du Conseil Régional de Sécurité (CRS)
article_manifest.summary: Agadez, 25 November (ANP) – The Governor of the Agadez Region, Major General Ibra Boulama Issa, chaired an ordinary meeting of the Regional Security Council (CRS) on Wednesday, 25 November 2026, in the Governor's Office meeting room. Several items were on the agenda for this meeting, including an assessment of the security situation in the region and various other matters.

article_manifest.title: Attack in Niono: FAMa are tracking down the attackers, with around ten terrorists neutralised
article_manifest.original_title: Attaque de Niono : les FAMa traquent les assaillants, une dizaine de terroristes neutralisés
article_manifest.summary: Niono attack: FAMa hunt down the attackers, around ten terrorists neutralised Operation Dougoukoloko saw FAMa and their partners carry out airstrikes in several Malian regions on 23 and 24 November 2026. In particular, they are continuing to hunt down the perpetrators of the attack on Niono. According to the General Staff of the Armed Forces, at least a dozen terrorists have been neutralised and seven motorbikes have been put out of use.

article_manifest.title: Road safety: Dièma Police Station arrests a suspect in an armed robbery on the Dièma–Kayes road
article_manifest.original_title: Sécurisation routière : le Commissariat de Police de Dièma interpelle un suspect de braquage sur l’axe Dièma–Kayes
article_manifest.summary: The vigilance of the police services enabled a further intervention on the Dièma-Kayes road. On 19 November 2026, the Dièma Police Station, led by Police Commissioner Djibril SANOU, arrested an individual suspected of being involved in an armed robbery, as part of the security operations initiated by Chief Police Superintendent Ousmane DIALLO, Regional Director of the National Police of Nioro du Sahel.

article_manifest.title: FAMa strikes in Nioro, Niono, Tonka, Debelin, Kidal, Dandougou and Sofara: several terrorists neutralised
article_manifest.original_title: Frappes des FAMa à Nioro, Niono, Tonka, Debelin, Kidal, Dandougou et Sofara : plusieurs terroristes neutralisés
article_manifest.summary: The General Staff of the Armed Forces informs the national public that the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), supported by their partners, are continuing their ongoing operations to monitor, control and secure the national territory as part of Operation Dougoukoloko. . On 23 and 24 November 2023, the FAMa carried out a series of strikes in several regions of the country, in particular continuing the hunt for the perpetrators of the attack on Niono.

article_manifest.title: Attackers kill 11 Niger soldiers in Diffa region
article_manifest.original_title: Attackers kill 11 Niger soldiers in Diffa region
article_manifest.summary: FILE: Nigerien special forces secure the Iferouane area during the Festival de l’Aïr in Niger, December 2, 2022. /VCG Boko Haram fighters on Tuesday, November 24, attacked a patrol in southeast Niger, killing 11 soldiers and wounding five others, the defense ministry said in a statement. The attack occurred near the village of Baroua in the Diffa region, it said.

article_manifest.title: Niono: The hospital is treating the injured despite the damage
article_manifest.original_title: Niono : l’hôpital soigne les blessés malgré les dégâts
article_manifest.summary: CURRENTLY On 21 November, teams from Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) and their colleagues from the Ministry of Health treated 26 injured people in Niono, in the Ségou region. They were working in a facility that was itself affected during the clashes. MSF reports two deaths during the violence that took place that day in Niono and Arabébé, near Niafounké, including a member of the healthcare staff.

article_manifest.title: Diéma–Kayes road: Suspected robber arrested near Madina
article_manifest.original_title: Axe Dièma-Kayes : un braqueur présumé arrêté près de Madina
article_manifest.summary: Axe Dièma-Kayes : un braqueur présumé arrêté près de Madina Le commissariat de police de Dièma a arrêté, le 19 novembre 2026, un jeune homme de 26 ans soupçonné de braquages sur l'axe Dièma-Kayes. Identifié par les initiales A.S., il a été interpellé près du village de Madina, après plusieurs signalements d'attaques sur cette route. Selon les enquêteurs, le suspect agissait avec un complice.

article_manifest.title: Terrorist attack in Niono and strike in higher education: The CNDH-Mali calls for the protection of civilians and for social dialogue
article_manifest.original_title: Attaque terroriste de Niono et grève de l’Enseignement supérieur : La CNDH-Mali appelle à la protection des civils et au dialogue social
article_manifest.summary: On 24 November 2026, the National Human Rights Commission (CNDH) issued two press releases, one on the attacks on civilian targets in Niono and the other on the indefinite strike by higher education and scientific research lecturers. In these two statements, the Commission calls for the protection of fundamental rights, the accountability of the stakeholders concerned, and dialogue.

article_manifest.title: Mali: JNIM jihadists issue an ultimatum to the inhabitants of Tonk
article_manifest.original_title: Mali: Les jihadistes du Jnim lancent un ultimatum aux habitants de Tonk
article_manifest.summary: In Mali, the al-Qaeda-linked Jnim is giving the inhabitants of Tonka until Friday to leave the town, after which this locality in the Timbuktu region will be placed under blockade. The jihadists are reacting to the deployment in the town of a detachment of the Malian army and its Russian partners from the Africa Corps. In the space of a year, JNIM has murdered several civilians in Tonka for their supposed links to the army.

article_manifest.title: Mali: Près de 350 combattants russes tués en trois ans, selon une enquête du Guardian
article_manifest.original_title: Mali: Près de 350 combattants russes tués en trois ans, selon une enquête du Guardian
article_manifest.summary: Près de 350 combattants russes ont perdu la vie au Mali entre septembre 2023 et septembre 2026, selon des données de l'agence nationale russe des statistiques (Rosstat), obtenues par deux groupes de hackers, Cyber Partisans et Silent Crow, et analysées par le quotidien britannique The Guardian. Le journal indique avoir pu associer la majorité des décès recensés à des affrontements connus.

article_manifest.title: Operation Dougoukoloko: 34 terrorists neutralised and significant logistical resources destroyed by FAMa
article_manifest.original_title: Opération Dougoukoloko : 34 terroristes neutralisés et d’importants moyens logistiques détruits par les FAMa
article_manifest.summary: The General Staff of the Armed Forces informs the nation that the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), supported by their partners, are continuing their ongoing operations to monitor, control and secure the national territory as part of Operation Dougoukoloko. Between 20 and 23 November 2026, the FAMa carried out a series of strikes against the logistical assets of armed terrorist groups.

article_manifest.title: Libye, Sahel, Soudan : comment l’Ukraine étend son empreinte militaire en Afrique
article_manifest.original_title: Libye, Sahel, Soudan : comment l’Ukraine étend son empreinte militaire en Afrique
article_manifest.summary: En frappant une corvette russe dans le port de Benghazi, Kiev a levé un peu plus le voile sur sa présence militaire en Libye. Du Maghreb au Sahel, l’Ukraine développe des partenariats sécuritaires pour contrer les intérêts de Moscou, mais aussi pour valoriser son expertise en matière de drones. À plusieurs milliers de kilomètres des côtes ukrainiennes, la guerre entre Kiev et Moscou se joue désormais jusque dans les ports africains.

article_manifest.title: Mali: Jnim jihadists issue an ultimatum to the inhabitants of Tonka, in the Timbuktu region
article_manifest.original_title: Mali: les jihadistes du Jnim lancent un ultimatum aux habitants de Tonka, dans la région de Tombouctou
article_manifest.summary: The voice messages were broadcast on Sunday, in several national languages: the JNIM is giving the inhabitants of Tonka who wish to leave five days, up to and including Friday, to do so. After this date, the jihadists are threatening to prevent all vehicles from entering or leaving the town. Even canoes will no longer be "allowed" to dock there.

article_manifest.summary: In Mali, Jnim, linked to al-Qaeda, has given the inhabitants of Tonka until Friday to leave the town, after which this locality in the Timbuktu region will be placed under blockade. The jihadists are reacting to the deployment in the town of a detachment of the Malian army and its Russian partners from the Africa Corps. .

article_manifest.title: Koulouba: Assimi Goïta meets with the military command
article_manifest.original_title: Koulouba: Assimi Goïta rencontre le commandement militaire
article_manifest.summary: Cette rencontre intervient dans un contexte marqué par des défis sécuritaires importants d’où les orientations du Chef suprême des Armées pour consolider la montée en puissance des FAMa et accroitre leur efficacité sur le terrain. Plusieurs chefs militaires étaient autour du président de la Transition non moins ministre de la Défense pour la circonstance. L’objectif affiché étant d’évaluer les forces armées et de sécurité, de renforcer la cohérence du commandement militaire et de définir les priorités stratégiques et opérationnelles.

article_manifest.title: Mali: The Transitional President Holds Discussions with the Military Command
article_manifest.original_title: Mali : le Président de la Transition échange avec le commandement militaire
article_manifest.summary: On Tuesday, 24 November 2026, in Koulouba, the President of Mali's Transition and Supreme Commander of the Armed Forces, General Assimi Goïta, chaired a meeting with the Chiefs of Staff and Directors of Services of the Defence and Security Forces (FDS). . According to the Malian Presidency, the aim of this meeting was to assess the situation of the forces, strengthen the coherence of command, and define the strategic and operational priorities of national defence.

article_manifest.title: Burkina Faso: Over 3,000 VDPs set to benefit from a training programme for their professional retraining
article_manifest.original_title: Burkina : Plus de 3 000 VDP bientôt bénéficiaires d’un programme de formation pour leur reconversion professionnelle
article_manifest.summary: Burkina Faso: More than 3,000 VDPs soon to benefit from a training programme for their professional retraining In recognition of the commitment of the Volunteers for the Defence of the Homeland (VDP), an agreement has been signed between Burkina Suudu Bawdè (the House of Skills of Burkina Faso) and the Brigade of Volunteers for the Defence of the Homeland (BVDP).

article_manifest.title: Fight against crime in Zinder: six repeat offenders, including one woman, arrested for at least five thefts committed less than a year after their release from prison
article_manifest.original_title: Lutte contre la criminalité à Zinder : six récidivistes, dont une femme, arrêtés pour au moins cinq vols commis moins d’un an après leur sortie de prison
article_manifest.summary: A criminal network of six individuals, including one woman, specialising in night-time burglaries, break-ins and handling stolen goods, has been dismantled by the Interregional Criminal Investigation Department of Zinder (SIRPJ/Zr) . Arrested following an operation carried out on the night of 17–18 November 2026 in the Jaguindi district, the suspects – all of them Nigerien nationals aged between 30 and 77 – admitted to having committed at least five burglaries since their release from prison less than a year ago.
